description: DC single, wages + interest, standard deduction
working: DC AGI = federal AGI = 86,000. DC standard deduction (single, D-40) 15,000 -> taxable 71,000. Rate table: over $60,000 not over $250,000 = $3,500 + 8.5% of excess over $60,000 -> 3,500 + 8.5% x 11,000 = 3,500 + 935 = 4,435.

description: DC joint itemizer: property tax uncapped, state income tax excluded, itemizing allowed because federal return itemizes
working: DC AGI = 180,000 + 3,000 + 10,000 = 193,000 (gains taxed as ordinary income). Federal return itemizes (SALT 11,575 DC tax + 12,000 property = 23,575 under the $40,400 cap; + 20,000 mortgage + 6,000 charity less 0.5% AGI floor 965 = 48,610 > 32,200), so DC may itemize. DC itemized = federal Schedule A without state/local income tax and without the federal SALT limit: 12,000 property + 20,000 mortgage + 6,000 charitable = 38,000 > $30,000 standard -> itemize. AGI is under $200,000, so the DC 5% itemized limitation does not apply. Taxable 193,000 - 38,000 = 155,000. Tax: $3,500 + 8.5% x (155,000 - 60,000) = 3,500 + 8,075 = 11,575.
